official_identity: The current Indian Health Service Shiprock page identifies Northern Navajo Medical Center at P.O. Box 160, Hwy 491 North, Shiprock, NM 87420 and describes it as the hospital for the Shiprock Service Unit.
regulatory_observation: 45 CFR 180.30 deems federally owned or operated hospitals, including hospitals operated by an Indian Health Program, in compliance with Part 180.
interpretation: CMS ownership, exact location agreement, and the current IHS hospital page support the federal scope disposition. This is not a claim about MRF availability or file quality.
next_action: Retain the federal scope exclusion unless CMS ownership or regulatory scope changes.
